Selected Projects

01

AI-Powered Product Search Engine for an E-Commerce Site

FastAPI + Cloud Run + BigQuery + Gemini

Connects the backend data sources to the customer's on-site search experience

ChallengeCustomers struggle to find products due to typos, wrong keyboard layout, Hebrew-vs-English brand names and free-form phrasing. The goal: a search engine that understands intent, not just words.

  • A cloud-hosted backend service connecting the product feed and the SEO data to the search interface the customer meets on the site.
  • An AI layer for query parsing that extracts brand, category, model, spec and price range from free text in Hebrew or English.
  • Hebrew NLP mechanisms: fixing wrong keyboard layout, normalizing typos, mapping brands between Hebrew and English, and distinguishing accessories from devices.
  • A multi-layer relevance and match-scoring model weighing textual match, historical click data and category intent.
  • A smart fallback mechanism: when there are no results, the system relaxes the criteria gradually and even asks the model to rephrase the intent into a broader term.
  • Operational resilience: request rate limiting, caching, access authentication, and self-healing of the data schema when the feed structure changes.

ResultA search engine that understands the customer's intent and returns accurate results even from garbled queries, improving the on-site search experience and conversion odds.

02

Large-Scale Automated SEO / GEO Agent

Make + BigQuery + Gemini + Airtable + HTTP

Scheduled automatic scenario · KSP e-commerce site

ChallengeProducing deep, commercial, SEO/GEO-optimized category content for thousands of category pages on an e-commerce site, automatically and at consistent quality.

  • An automatic scenario triggered via an endpoint, pulling records from the database and running scheduled queries every night.
  • Running an AI model to generate commercial content for each page, including titles, meta descriptions, internal links and an FAQ schema.
  • An automatic quality-control mechanism: checks on title and description length, table presence, schema presence, and fallback flags for every field.
  • Sending the content back to the site software interface, and streaming reports to the database and email.
  • Batch processing, a duplicate-prevention mechanism, and routing by success or failure state.
  • Embedding an FAQ schema and rich content so a single page produces several presences on Google: the AI overview, the product card and the organic result - across thousands of pages.

ResultMeasurable result: the average position of thousands of Non-Brand terms in Search Console rose from ~10 to ~3. On top of that, a single page now produces several presences on the Google results page (AI overview, product card and organic result) - across thousands of pages, with no manual intervention.

03

Warehouse Carton Prediction & Optimization

BigQuery ML (K-Means) + Streamlit + Plotly + GitHub

Clustering model and 3D visualization

ChallengeThe warehouse needs to know which standard carton sizes to stock, and to automatically match each product to the optimal carton to save volume, material and shipping costs.

  • Training a clustering model on the warehouse product dimensions, with hyperparameter tuning and optimization by a cluster-quality metric.
  • Identifying four optimal carton groups (standard, wide, high-volume, long) from the actual data, instead of a manual guess.
  • Building an interface where you pick a product and get the best-fit carton, with a volume-utilization calculation.
  • An interactive 3D visualization showing the product inside the selected carton, with a fully responsive Hebrew layout.

ResultTurning a business packing problem into a machine-learning model with a visual decision tool, saving volume and cost and matching a carton automatically to every product.

Smart Telegram Customer-Management Bot

Telegram + AI Agent + Airtable + Data Store

Over 30 modules, multi-step routing

ChallengeProviding smart automatic responses to customers on Telegram, detecting user intent, retaining conversation context and routing to the right action or a human agent.

  • Listening to Telegram updates with a primary router that directs by message type and intent.
  • A secondary router with eight distinct intent paths - each running a dedicated AI agent or a matching database action.
  • Persistent conversation memory retaining context between messages.

07

Home Shopping & Task Management App

WhatsApp + Make + AI + Firestore

A bot that turns free-form group messages into an organized list

ChallengeA family manages shopping and tasks in a WhatsApp group with free-form messages. The goal: turn the mess automatically into a categorized, shared list.

  • A listener on the WhatsApp group, filtering by group ID and authorized sender numbers, sending every message to the automation engine.
  • An AI layer that parses free Hebrew text into a structured item list, breaks one message into several items and classifies each as a category or a task.
  • Storing the items in a shared database, with an installable web app for real-time viewing and management.
  • Operational resilience: system health monitoring, automatic recovery and persistent WhatsApp connection management.

ResultTurning unstructured daily communication into an organized, shared system, fully combining a bot, an AI layer and an app.
